## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes, and the smoke tests if the app changed (`npm run build && npm run test:e2e`)
- [ ] New visible text is in `src/renderer/i18n/locales/en.json`, and the layout works in `--locale=en-XA` and `--locale=ar-XB`
- [ ] User-facing changes are in `CHANGELOG.md` under "Unreleased"
- [ ] The commit messages follow Conventional Commits
